steps.en: Install the pack into your agent with the skills CLI
steps.zh: 用 skills CLI 把整包装进 agent

steps.en: Ask the agent to animate a component
steps.zh: 让 agent 给某个组件加动效

steps.en: Gates on how often users see it — keyboard or 100+/day actions get no animation
steps.zh: 先按看到的频率过闸：键盘触发或一天上百次的不做

steps.en: Names the purpose, then takes curve and duration from fixed tables
steps.zh: 先说出用途，再从固定表里取曲线和时长

steps.en: Before merging, call the strict reviewer on the motion diff
steps.zh: 合并前手动调起严格评审看动效改动

steps.en: Returns Before/After/Why rows and Block or Approve — deleting the animation is fix #1
steps.zh: 出前后对照表和 Block/Approve，首选删掉动画

steps.en: Ask for an audit of every animation in the app
steps.zh: 让它体检整个应用的动效

steps.en: Writes read-only plans with exact values and file:line excerpts any agent can run
steps.zh: 只读分析，写出带精确数值和行号的计划，任何 agent 可照做

value.en: Motion calls get made against one explicit bar — including the call not to animate — instead of the agent's default easing and durations
value.zh: 动效怎么做（包括不做）按一把明确的尺子定，而不是 agent 默认的曲线和时长
